summary: YSX Tech Co., Ltd, a Cayman Islands automotive-services issuer listed in the US, furnished a Form 6-K on October 2, 2026 containing notice and proxy materials for an extraordinary general meeting to be held October 19, 2026, mapped to a US special-meeting proxy. Holders on the September 30, 2026 record date will vote on (1) an ordinary resolution increasing authorized share capital from US$50,000 to US$220,000,000, creating roughly 1.9995 trillion additional Class A and 199.97 billion Class B shares at US$0.0001 par, (2) a special resolution shortening general-meeting notice to five clear days, and (3) adoption of amended articles. The board recommends FOR all proposals. No deal terms, price, stake, or advisor are disclosed; watch dilution and overhang from the massive authorized-share expansion.
